title: Andrew Lloyd Webber – The Premiere Collection CD 1988 Compilation MCA Records
descriptionText: The Andrew Lloyd Webber – The Premiere Collection CD is a 1988 compilation album released by MCA Records. This Best of Andrew Lloyd Webber album features a selection of the artist's most popular hits, including musical compositions in the genre of Stage and Screen music. With a multicolor jewel case in good condition and an inlay in very good condition, this CD is a valuable addition to any music enthusiast's collection from the 1980s era. Featuring acoustic guitar and showcasing the musical style of Andrew Lloyd Webber, this album is a must-have for fans of Musicals and Musical theater.
